shipped_rows.title_o: A bimodal extension of the Eriksen flanker task
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: In summary, we found significant evidence for bimodal Flanker effects, F(2, 292) = 83.94, p < .001, np2 = .37, and a significant interaction of congruency and flanker modality, F(2, 292) = 4.28, p = .015, np2 = .03.
